extraction.design_notes: This was a 12 week prospective randomized controlled trial. This was a single‐blind trial, blinded only to the subjects, and the researchers were informed to facilitate intervention and response.

key_inclusion_criteria: a confirmed diagnosis of type 2 diabetes, age over 18 years, recent hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) measurement taken within the previous 2 weeks showing levels above 7.0%, strong self‐management ability, possession of a smartphone, and the capability to learn to use the internet

In total, 180 patients with type 2 diabetes were randomly allocated into the control group (group A, n = 90) and the experimental group (group B, n = 90).
The integrated data platform with dietary management was applied to Group B.
